Operational Context & The Latency Void
The 22-Minute Void: Why Telemedicine Fails Beyond Low Earth Orbit
In deep space, speed-of-light delays render terrestrial flight surgeons unable to intervene in real-time medical events.
Interplanetary Signal Propagation FATAL DELAY
Low Earth Orbit (ISS): ~0.05 seconds (Live Video/Audio)
Lunar Gateway: ~1.3 seconds (Direct Radio Link)
Mars Transit / Surface: 4.3 to 22.4 minutes (Each Way)

A single medical consultation cycle (astronaut speaks, audio travels, flight surgeon reviews, recommendation returns) requires 44.8 minutes round-trip at conjunction. Acute events—cardiac arrhythmia, toxic cabin leak, acute barotrauma, ocular swelling—demand instantaneous onboard decision support.

The Cloud & CDN Failure Mode in Deep Space

Modern clinical tools rely on cloud APIs, centralized vector databases, remote GPUs, and CDN web dependencies. In interplanetary space, any system requiring internet connectivity immediately crashes.

The 5 Spaceflight Hazards (NASA HRP) PHYSIOLOGICAL CHALLENGES
1

Cardiovascular Deconditioning & Fluid Redistribution

Cephalad fluid shift causes blood volume pooling in the upper torso and head, baroreceptor reset, stroke volume changes, and orthostatic intolerance upon gravitational re-entry.

2

SANS (Spaceflight Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome)

Optic disc edema, globe flattening, choroidal folds, and hyperopic refractive shifts occur in ~70% of long-duration astronauts due to elevated intracranial fluid pressure.

3

Musculoskeletal Demineralization & Lumbar Elongation

Bone density loss at 1.0–1.5% per month in weight-bearing bones. Microgravity spinal decompression expands intervertebral discs causing acute paraspinal pain.

4

Deep Space Ionizing Radiation (GCR & SPE)

Galactic Cosmic Rays and Solar Particle Events penetrate habitat hulls, inducing DNA double-strand breaks, immune suppression, and long-term carcinogenesis.

5

Circadian Disruption & Behavioral Degradation

Non-circadian light-dark cycles and high mission payloads lead to acute sleep deficits (<5.5h/night), impaired cognitive vigilance, and autonomic fatigue.

FASTER-WHISPER BASE.EN (CPU INT8)

Natural Language Interface & Hands-Free Interaction
100% Local Speech AI: Zero Cloud, Mission-Wide Voice Control
Astronauts in space cannot rely on mouse or touchpads during EVA prep, exercise, or gloved operations.
The Local Speech-to-Text Pipeline
Acoustic Model: faster-whisper base.en (CPU, int8)
VAD (Voice Activity Detection): vad_filter=True, ~1.2s auto-cut
Domain Vocabulary Biasing: Medical, Spaceflight & Sol Lexicon
Inference Latency: <450 ms (Direct CPU)
Safety-Guarded State Transitions

Voice state transitions are strictly guarded against accidental microphone capture. Saying "sleep solaris" immediately frees the WebRTC microphone streams. Saying "how was my sleep" will never accidentally trigger the sleep state due to context-aware grammar parsing.

Zero-Dependency Graceful Fallback

If the Whisper model weights are absent or mic permissions are withheld, GET /api/voice/status reports available: false, and the UI cleanly falls back to a typed command input without crashing.

MEDIAN / MAD ASTRONAUT BASELINES
Data Science & Medical Ground Truth
Transparent Anomaly Detection & The Anti-Hallucination Protocol
Rejecting black-box medical claims: how SOLARIS guarantees clinical interpretability and safety.
Individual Astronaut Baseline Normalization

General population medical "averages" are dangerously inaccurate in spaceflight, where individual microgravity adaptation causes unique fluid redistribution and heart rate baselines. SOLARIS normalizes biometrics against each astronaut's personal history:

Deviation = |x - Median| / (1.4826 × MAD)
Robust Non-Parametric Median Absolute Deviation (MAD) resistant to sensor noise and transient outliers
Dual-Model Anomaly Architecture
IF

Unsupervised Isolation Forest

Calculates a continuous statistical deviation score (0.0 to 1.0) without inventing clinical disease labels or probabilities.

RF

Random Forest Feature Attribution

Extracts top physiological contributors (e.g. HRV drop of 24 ms + core temp rise of 0.5°C) with explanatory factor weights.

ZERO INVENTED COMPOSITE SCORES
Authoritative Model Registry & Governance STRICT AUDIT

In deep space, an algorithm that pretends to "diagnose" without definitive proof is a mission-fatal hazard. SOLARIS enforces strict model gating:

Model / Endpoint Status Clinical Boundary
Cardiovascular Anomaly OPERATIONAL Statistical deviation score only; no disease claim.
Immune Transcriptomics EXPLORATORY PCA coordinate projection; observational only.
Radiation Dosimetry OPERATIONAL Descriptive daily absorbed dose (mGy/day).
Ocular & Bone Observation OPERATIONAL Pass-through verified physical measurements.
Predictive Sleep Model QUARANTINED Overfitted regression disabled; direct actigraphy only.
Stress & Anxiety Classifiers QUARANTINED Quarantined due to lack of spaceflight ground truth.
QUARANTINE ENFORCEMENT:
Quarantined models return explicit 503 or disabled markers. SOLARIS will never display unverified predictions as clinical facts.

NASA OPEN DATA

Single-cell RNA transcriptomics and immune profiling from the Inspiration4 commercial astronaut cohort.

Scientific Role: Exploratory immune repertoire PCA projection. Tracks immune cell population shifts during spaceflight without asserting unvalidated diagnostic classifications.
NASA OSDR OSD-571 (Inspiration4 Proteomics)
NASA OPEN DATA

Circulating plasma proteomics profiling systemic inflammation, vascular tone, and cytokine signaling during spaceflight.

Scientific Role: Molecular and proteomic research reference exploration. Predictive classifiers are quarantined in accordance with ethical AI governance.
PhysioNet: Autonomic Aging (Goldberger et al.)
PHYSIONET

Cardiovascular autonomic regulation database containing continuous Lead-II ECG, RR intervals, and blood pressure dynamics.

Scientific Role: Ground truth reference distribution for healthy resting ECG RR-intervals, RMSSD heart rate variability (HRV), and sinus rhythm baselines.
PhysioNet: MMASH (Rossi et al.)
PHYSIONET

Multilevel Monitoring of Activity and Sleep in Healthy People combining 24-hour actigraphy, continuous heart rate, and sleep logs.

Scientific Role: Calibrates actigraphy sleep architecture and circadian rhythmicity analysis without synthetic regression score extrapolation.
Strict Attribution Compliance: All datasets, licenses, and file paths are formally documented in ATTRIBUTIONS.md. Unknown licenses are explicitly marked as TODO rather than invented.
